description: The ASUS TUF Gaming A15 (FA506NCQ-IN080W) is a powerhouse laptop built for gamers, students, and creators who demand uncompromising performance. Powered by the AMD Ryzen 7 170 processor with 8 cores and 16 threads clocking up to 4.75GHz, paired with an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 Laptop GPU featuring 4GB GDDR6 memory, it handles demanding games and creative workloads with ease. The 15.6-inch FHD IPS-level display with a 144Hz refresh rate and Adaptive-Sync delivers smooth, tear-free visuals. With 16GB DDR5-4800 RAM upgradeable to 64GB and a 512GB PCIe 4.0 NVMe SSD expandable to 2TB, multitasking and storage are never a concern. Built to MIL-STD-810H military-grade standards, this laptop is designed to endure tough conditions. The 1-Zone RGB backlit keyboard, DTS Audio Processing, AI noise-cancelling microphone, Wi-Fi 6 connectivity, and comprehensive cooling with 4 heatpipes ensure a premium gaming experience. Weighing 2.30 kg and running Windows 11 Home, it comes with a 1-year international warranty.
